SHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTRY
N. 757
5 / 4 / 41
April 4, 1941.

Assassination of Tung Chu ( 董 樞 ), translator
of C. V. F.

At 12.20 p.m. April 3, 1941, Tung Chu alias
Tung Siao Han ( 童 肖 涵 ), translator, employed by
the French Municipal Council, was fatally shot by some
unknown person on Avenue Joffre near Rue Baron Gros ,
whilst en route from office to his home at 223 Rue Lagrene.

A suspect was arrested by the French Police
near the scen. of the crime. The arrested person, named
Chang Shi Kwen, ( 張 錫 坤 ) is an ex-constable of the
French Police who is said to have joined some "special
service" organization in the Western District.

The reason for the assassination is at present
unknown, but it is thought the motive might be of a
political nature, as the deceased often showed strong
patriotic feelings.

D.B. (cwse)
Comr.
Sir:
I
J. Sharman
A. C. (S. Br.)

上海公共租界工部局警务处
警务处登记室
编号 757
1941年4月5日

1941年4月4日。

法公董局译员董枢（Tung Chu）遇刺案

1941年4月3日下午12时20分，受雇于法国公董局的译员董枢，又名童肖涵（Tung Siao Han），在从办公室前往拉格莱尼路（Rue Lagrene）223号住所的途中，于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）靠近格罗男爵路（Rue Baron Gros）处，被不明身份者枪击身亡。

法国警方在犯罪现场附近逮捕了一名嫌疑人。被捕者名为张锡坤（Chang Shi Kwen），系法国警察局前巡捕，据称已加入西区某“特别服务”组织。

目前尚不清楚刺杀原因，但鉴于死者经常表现出强烈的爱国情感，推测其动机可能具有政治性质。

D.B. (cwse)
警务总监
致：
J. Sharman
助理总监（特别分部）
4月5日

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处总监办公室）
